name: Hurricane Maria
subtitle: Puerto Rico · September 2017

events.label: Puerto Rico landfall
events.detail: NHC estimated landfall near Yabucoa at 10:15Z. Used as a disruption reference; site shutdown time is unavailable.

events.label: FDA testimony
events.detail: FDA described Maria worsening existing IV-solution shortages.

patients.label: Potential delayed encounters avoided
patients.assumption: Difference between market and fair allocation. Four unfilled units represent one delayed encounter; unique patients are unavailable.

dollars.label: Administrative disruption avoided
dollars.assumption: Avoided delayed encounters × $48 assumed administrative cost. Contract savings and cancelled procedures are excluded from this total.

co2.label: Planned shipment substitution
co2.assumption: Four units per avoided encounter × 0.5 kg × 1,200 km × assumed (0.60 air − 0.08 ground) kg CO₂e per tonne-km. Shipment count and mode are simulated.

co2.label: Stock expiry avoidance
co2.assumption: Waste is not quantified because observed expiry and purchasing records are unavailable.

equity.label: Share of prevented facility stockouts in high-SVI counties
equity.assumption: Hospitals in counties with CDC SVI ≥ 0.75 among those stocked out under market and protected under fair allocation.

notes: Inventories, routing, contract prices, per-product shares and recovery durations are planning assumptions. Bands span inventory and recovery sensitivity.
Historical weather products enter at their issue timestamp. Retrospective supply metadata and the present FDA snapshot limit this counterfactual to a forecast replay.
Maria affects small-volume parenteral bags in this replay. Large-volume IV solutions were not manufactured by Baxter in Puerto Rico.

Timeline snapshots use expected supply loss = assumed site share × the latest selected issued-forecast hazard score. Updates occur at meaningful hazard changes and the alert. Equity comparison conditions on an outage.

drivers: Archived forecast hazard intersects a concentrated supply site.
All hospitals receive the same planning alert. Inventory and site shares require operational confirmation.
alert.message: Baxter Jayuya is exposed to severe weather. Review IV supply buffers and activate a coordinated pharmacy plan.

backtest.notes: Lead time uses Puerto Rico landfall as the disruption reference. Weather issue timestamps are respected. Priors, static supply links, and current FDA snapshot make this a retrospective counterfactual with no prospective validation.
